body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not pay all provider types prospectively or alternatively does not demonstrate that it is not a generally-accepted practice for all provider types, as required by 98.45(m)(1). (Plan Question 4.4.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through August 1, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 08/01/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Begin work with current and new payments systems vendor, on steps needed to transition systems to prospective payments 09/30/2024 2 Finalize work with new payments systems vendor to ensure that requirements of new system, to be launched in 2025, are fully set up to provide prospective payments and to do so according to our payment schedule 12/31/2024 3 Bring proposed policy change to Early Childhood Care and Education Advisory Council for endorsement and state Board of Elementary and Secondary Education for approval 12/31/2024 4 Work with team managing current payment system to finalize and schedule a conversion period from payments after service provision to prospective payments 02/28/2025 5 Develop communications for the field, explaining the rollout of prospective payments, along with a timeline for various payments 03/31/2025 6 Policy change goes into final rule 04/30/2025 7 Test new payments system in development, to ensure payments continue prospectively 06/30/2025

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency’s payment rates for preschoolers in center-based care are not sufficient to ensure equal access, as required by 98.45(a). (Plan Question 4.3.2a) Overall Target Completion Date: 08/01/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Analyze market rate survey and flag possible rate increases 06/30/2024 2 Prepare a cost estimation of increased expense of rate increase and expected impact on overall decrease in number of children to be served 01/31/2025 3 Plan stakeholder meetings to discuss upcoming proposed policy change 04/30/2025 4 Take proposed policy change to Early Childhood Care and Education Advisory Council for endorsement and state Board of Elementary and Secondary Education for approval 06/30/2025 5 Program new rates into payment system and test 09/30/2025 6 Policy change goes into final rule, Lead Agency conducts broader communications with the field 10/31/2025

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not provide grants or contracts for direct services for children with disabilities, as required by 98.30(b)(1). (Plan Question 4.5.1i). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through August 1, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 08/01/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Ask ACF-OCC and peer Lead Agency leaders for clarity about and examples of grants or contracts for direct services for children with disabilities at regional meetings and STAM 08/31/2024 2 Request from our regional office and ACF-OCC TA centers, on our monthly calls, technical assistance to better understand how other states are meeting or planning to meet this requirement, to help us in implementing a plan for Louisiana as well 09/30/2024 3 Begin consulting with stakeholders who specialize in serving the needs of young children with disabilities and their families, to begin considering what such grants or contracts would look like, where they might most be needed, and where young children with disabilities might best be served 04/30/2025 4 Work with the vendor that is building our updated data system, including our subsidy program application process and payments system, on the development of any necessary modules for the administration of grants or contracts for direct services for children with disabilities 09/30/2025 5 Begin piloting some grants or contracts for direct services for young children with disabilities 12/31/2025 6 Assess pilot implementation and make any needed adjustments 06/30/2026
